collection.title: Alfa Romeo 159 Saloon 2005 to 2011 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Alfa Romeo 159 Saloon 2005 to 2011 model requires a 23" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
